# Where to sell Chimera AEC agents to businesses

## 1. Buyer segments

| Segment | Pain | Offer | Lead agents | Economic buyer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engineering consultancies | Scheme-stage design is slow; fee pressure; coordination churn between disciplines. | Multidisciplinary scheme in a day with clause-level compliance and verification. | Structural, Seismic, Wind Engineering, HVAC, Electrical, Fire Engineering, Code Intelligence, Independent Verifier | Discipline directors, digital/innovation lead |
| Contractors (pre-construction) | Bids priced on incomplete designs; VE that later fails; crane and programme risk. | Tender-stage BOQ, VE with proof, foundation choice, CPM and cranes. | Cost & BOQ, Value Engineering, Construction Planning, Foundation Optimiser, BIM Coordination | Pre-construction director, chief estimator |
| Developers & owners | Committing to sites and massing before costs, carbon and risk are known. | Site feasibility comparisons, budget and carbon certainty, later a digital twin. | Intake & Brief, Architecture, Cost & BOQ, Carbon & Resilience, Digital Twin & Operations | Development manager, head of design |
| Facility & portfolio managers | Reactive maintenance and energy waste. | Predictive maintenance and operational optimisation. | Digital Twin & Operations | Head of FM, energy manager |
| Regulators & insurers | Manual plan review; poor visibility of physical risk. | Automated pre-checks, verification reports, risk screening. | Code Intelligence, Independent Verifier, Seismic, Carbon & Resilience | Chief building official, risk/underwriting lead |

## 2. Channels

> Programmes and URLs are real, but eligibility, fees and review times change. Verify current terms with each provider before applying.

### Direct sales to engineering consultancies
*Direct* · effort **High** · time to revenue **2–6 months**

- **Reaches:** Multidisciplinary engineering & architecture firms (structural, MEP, façade, fire, sustainability teams)
- **How to sell:** Founder-led demos on the firm's own past project; a 4–6 week paid pilot on one live scheme; expand by discipline seats.
- **Package as:** Professional seats + API runs
- **Lead agents:** Structural, Seismic, Wind Engineering, HVAC, Electrical, Fire Engineering, Code Intelligence, Independent Verifier

### Direct sales to contractors & design-builders
*Direct* · effort **High** · time to revenue **2–6 months**

- **Reaches:** General contractors, design-build and pre-construction / estimating teams
- **How to sell:** Lead with bid-stage value: VE, foundation choice, cranes, programme and BOQ in days. Price per tender or per project.
- **Package as:** Per-project licence or Professional seats for pre-construction
- **Lead agents:** Cost & BOQ, Value Engineering, Construction Planning, Foundation Optimiser, BIM Coordination

### Developers, owners & owner's reps
*Direct* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **1–4 months**

- **Reaches:** Real-estate developers, REITs, hospitals, universities, public owners
- **How to sell:** Feasibility-as-a-service: compare sites and massing options on cost, carbon and area before appointing consultants; later upsell the digital twin.
- **Package as:** Feasibility reports per site + Enterprise operations
- **Lead agents:** Intake & Brief, Architecture, Cost & BOQ, Carbon & Resilience, Digital Twin & Operations

### Autodesk App Store / Autodesk Platform Services
*Platform partner* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **3–9 months** · https://apps.autodesk.com

- **Reaches:** Revit, AutoCAD and Autodesk Construction Cloud users
- **How to sell:** Publish a Revit add-in or ACC integration that sends the model/brief to the agents API and returns results; list it on the App Store; join the Autodesk developer network.
- **Package as:** Add-in (free) + paid API subscription
- **Lead agents:** BIM Coordination, Structural, Code Intelligence, Cost & BOQ

### Procore App Marketplace
*Marketplace* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **3–9 months** · https://marketplace.procore.com

- **Reaches:** General contractors and owners running projects in Procore
- **How to sell:** Build a Procore integration that pushes issues/RFIs, schedule and BOQ into Procore; apply as a technology partner and list the app.
- **Package as:** Construction & cost agents as an integrated app
- **Lead agents:** Construction Planning, Cost & BOQ, BIM Coordination, Value Engineering

### Bentley iTwin ecosystem
*Platform partner* · effort **High** · time to revenue **6–12 months** · https://developer.bentley.com

- **Reaches:** Infrastructure owners and digital-twin programmes
- **How to sell:** Expose the operations and verification agents as an iTwin-connected service; join Bentley's developer/partner programme.
- **Package as:** Digital-twin analytics (Enterprise)
- **Lead agents:** Digital Twin & Operations, Independent Verifier, Carbon & Resilience

### Trimble / Graphisoft / Nemetschek ecosystems
*Platform partner* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **6–12 months**

- **Reaches:** Tekla, Trimble Connect, Archicad and Allplan users (strong in Europe & APAC)
- **How to sell:** IFC-based connector (the engine already exports validated IFC4) plus an add-on listing in each vendor's partner/add-on programme.
- **Package as:** openBIM connector + API
- **Lead agents:** BIM Coordination, Structural, Façade Engineering

### AWS / Azure / Google Cloud marketplaces
*Cloud marketplace* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **3–6 months after first enterprise lead** · https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace

- **Reaches:** Enterprise buyers who prefer to buy through existing cloud commitments
- **How to sell:** List the SaaS (and a private-deployment option) as a marketplace offer; private offers let enterprises buy against committed cloud spend.
- **Package as:** Enterprise annual contract / metered API
- **Lead agents:** All agents

### Claude & MCP ecosystem
*AI ecosystem* · effort **Low** · time to revenue **1–3 months**

- **Reaches:** Businesses already using Claude (Claude Code, Claude apps, Claude API) for engineering work
- **How to sell:** Ship the included Claude Skill and an MCP server that wraps /api/v1; list it in MCP server registries and connector directories (check each directory's current submission process); charge for the API key.
- **Package as:** Skill + MCP connector (free) → paid API key
- **Lead agents:** All agents

### Resellers, BIM consultancies & system integrators
*Partners* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **4–9 months**

- **Reaches:** Autodesk/Bentley resellers, BIM consultancies, digital-transformation integrators
- **How to sell:** 20–30 % reseller margin or referral fee; give them a white-label workspace and demo projects; they bundle it with training and implementation.
- **Package as:** White-label Enterprise
- **Lead agents:** All agents

### Industry events & communities
*Events* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **Pipeline in 1–3 months**

- **Reaches:** AEC technology leaders and early adopters
- **How to sell:** Speak and demo at events such as Autodesk University, ENR FutureTech, Greenbuild and CTBUH conferences; publish validation case studies; run webinars with a design firm customer.
- **Package as:** Lead generation for direct sales
- **Lead agents:** All agents

### Permitting authorities & public sector
*Public sector* · effort **High** · time to revenue **9–18 months**

- **Reaches:** Plan-review departments and governments adopting BIM-based e-submission
- **How to sell:** Offer automated clause-level pre-checks and verification reports to applicants or reviewers; respond to govtech tenders, usually with an integrator partner.
- **Package as:** Code Intelligence + Verifier as a pre-check service
- **Lead agents:** Code Intelligence, Accessibility, Fire Engineering, Independent Verifier

### Insurers, lenders & ESG data buyers
*Direct* · effort **Medium** · time to revenue **3–9 months**

- **Reaches:** Property insurers, construction lenders, green-bond and ESG analysts
- **How to sell:** Sell portfolio-level seismic, flood/heat-resilience and embodied-carbon screening as reports or data feeds via API.
- **Package as:** Per-asset screening reports / data API
- **Lead agents:** Seismic, Carbon & Resilience, Geotechnical, Independent Verifier

## 4. Launch plan

### 1. Prove (Weeks 1–4)
- Re-run 2–3 real past projects with friendly firms and publish the comparison
- Record a 5-minute demo per segment
- Set up API keys, usage metering and billing (e.g. Stripe)

### 2. Pilot (Weeks 5–10)
- Sign 3–5 paid pilots (one consultancy, one contractor, one developer)
- Ship the Claude Skill + MCP connector and list them
- Start the Autodesk or Procore integration based on pilot demand

### 3. Scale (Weeks 11–24)
- Convert pilots to annual contracts and case studies
- Launch marketplace listings (Autodesk/Procore, then AWS/Azure)
- Recruit 2–3 reseller/integrator partners in your home region

## 5. Before you sell

- **Position as decision support, sealed by a licensed engineer** — Software cannot take engineer-of-record responsibility; say so in contracts, UI and reports.
- **Professional / technology E&O insurance** — Enterprise buyers and channel partners will ask for it before signing.
- **Terms of service, DPA and acceptable-use policy** — Required by every marketplace and enterprise procurement team.
- **Security: SSO, audit log, encryption, SOC 2 Type II roadmap** — Large consultancies and contractors run security questionnaires.
- **Validation pack** — Publish benchmark comparisons (closed-form tests, a past project re-analysed) — the Verifier agent's output is the core of this.
- **Code-text licensing** — Reference clause numbers only; do not reproduce copyrighted code text without a licence from the publisher.
- **Data residency & private deployment option** — Public-sector, defence and many EU/APAC buyers require it.
- **Calibrated rate books & carbon factors per market** — Local cost and EPD data turns a demo into a trusted estimate.

## 6. What is already sellable in this repo

- **SaaS workspace** (`aec/`): authentication, projects, all agents, BIM/IFC, compliance, reports.
- **Metered API**: keys in Settings → API keys; `GET /api/v1/agents` (public catalog), `POST /api/v1/analyze` (runs agents, 5,000 runs/key/month).
- **Claude Skill**: `aec/skills/chimera-aec-agents/` — distribute to Claude users; they pay for the API key.
